title: Doctor Strange
tagline: Bend reality. Bend the rules on seconds.
about: An arrogant surgeon loses the use of his hands and finds the mystic arts in Kathmandu.
cue: Serve the snacks when Mordo hands Strange the Wi-Fi password.

Chicken and ginger dumplings, tomato acharHow to make it400g chicken mince2 spring onions, sliced1 tbsp grated ginger1/4 tsp ground cumin30 dumpling wrappers3 tomatoes1 red chilli2 tbsp toasted sesame seedsMix the chicken with the spring onions, ginger and cumin.Fill the wrappers and pleat closed.Steam in batches until cooked through.Roast the tomatoes, then blitz with the chilli and sesame seeds into an achar to serve alongside.Mirror Dimension pesto parmesan pinwheelsFolded like New York in the Mirror Dimension. Pesto and parmesan puff pastry spiralsHow to make it2 sheets of puff pastry3 tbsp basil pesto50g parmesan, grated1 egg, beatenSpread the pastry with pesto and parmesan.Roll up, slice into spirals and brush with egg.Bake at 200°C until golden.Wong's chicken and avocado sandwichesWhite bread, shredded roast chook, herbed mayo, avocado and cucumber, crusts off, for library dutyHow to make itNot on tonight's cookSoft white bread layered with shredded roast chicken, herbed mayo, smashed avocado and cucumber, crusts off, cut into neat fingers.Shred 400g roast chicken meat.Mix 4 tbsp mayo with chopped chives, parsley, a squeeze of lemon and salt, then fold through the chicken.Smash 2 avocados with lemon juice and salt.Spread 6 slices of white bread with avocado, top with the chicken and thin cucumber slices, and close with 6 more slices.Trim the crusts and cut each into 3 fingers.From the hearthKamar-Taj dal bhatThe Ancient One shows Strange the astral plane first. Red lentil dal, rice, spinachHow to make it300g red lentils1 tsp ground turmeric4 garlic cloves1 tbsp grated ginger1 L water1 tsp cumin seeds2 tbsp ghee300g basmati rice200g spinachRinse the lentils and put in a pot with the turmeric, garlic, ginger and water.Simmer until soft and thick.Cook the rice.Fry the cumin seeds in the ghee and pour over the dal.Wilt the spinach with a little garlic and serve with the dal and rice.Strange's butter-basted rib eyeSeared hard with garlic and thyme, wine sauce and gratin, from his life before the crashHow to make itNot on tonight's cookThick rib eye seared hard and basted with garlic thyme butter, sliced with a red wine sauce, potato gratin and charred asparagus.Bake 1kg thinly sliced potatoes layered with 300ml cream, garlic and salt at 180°C for 1 hour.Season 2 x 500g rib eyes and sear in a very hot pan for 4 minutes a side.Add 60g butter, 2 crushed garlic cloves and thyme, and spoon the foaming butter over for 2 minutes.Rest 10 minutes.Reduce 250ml red wine and 250ml stock in the pan by half.Grill 2 bunches asparagus.Sweet thingsTime loop cinnamon scrollsBrown sugar cinnamon scrolls. Dormammu, I've come to bargainHow to make it400g plain flour7g dried yeast250ml warm milk50g butter, melted, for the dough60g butter, softened, for the filling80g brown sugar2 tsp ground cinnamon150g icing sugar2 tbsp milkMix the flour, yeast, warm milk and melted butter into a dough and knead briefly.Cover and prove until doubled.Roll out and spread with softened butter, brown sugar and cinnamon, then roll up and cut into twelve.Bake at 190°C until golden.Glaze with icing sugar mixed with milk. Dormammu, we've come to bargain.Mugs and cupsMasala chaiGinger, cardamom and cinnamon milk tea. Just tea.How to make it4 black tea bags500ml water1 piece ginger, sliced4 cardamom pods, crushed1 cinnamon stick500ml full cream milk3 tbsp raw sugarSimmer the tea bags in the water with the ginger, cardamom and cinnamon.Add the milk and sugar and bring back to a simmer.Strain into cups.
